bundle.shortDescription: Local control center for your Claude Code projects.
bundle.longDescription: Hive runs the MissionControlAI dashboard and its embedded-terminal server entirely on your machine as two Node sidecars supervised by a Tauri shell. Your projects database (SQLite) lives under your macOS app-data dir; the terminal spawns Claude Code in your real project directories.
